title: Timezone-aware incremental CSV rollups for scheduled exports
creator: Priya Raman
description: Add a timezone-aware incremental CSV rollup path to scheduled customer usage exports. Many customers request exports aligned to their local business days (midnight in customer timezone) and want compact incremental CSVs rather than full snapshots. This ticket covers backend changes to compute per-tenant export watermarks, normalize events to tenant timezone (including DST handling), generate incremental CSV rollups (day/week/month), and make exports resumable and verifiable when delivered to S3 or via webhooks.
acceptance_criteria: Exports can be configured per-tenant with a timezone string (IANA tz) and rollup window (daily/weekly/monthly)
Incremental CSVs contain only events after the stored watermark; watermark updates are idempotent and crash-resilient
CSV rows are normalized to tenant local date fields and include UTC timestamps; DST transitions are handled so rows land in the intended local bucket
Signed S3 upload flow supports multi-part uploads for files >100MB and returns a delivery manifest with checksum and object size
Webhook deliveries include a delivery manifest URL and retry/backpressure semantics with idempotency keys
System exposes observability: per-tenant watermark lag, export duration, failed deliveries, and payload size metrics
Contract test and integration test covering timezone edge cases (DST start/end) and resumable delivery after a crash are added to CI
comments: 2026-03-09 Priya Raman: Scoping note - customers A, B requested exports aligned to local midnight for billing reconciliation. Initial design doc linked.

2026-03-10 Jordan Lee: Spike complete. Implemented prototype that converts events to tenant local date and groups by local day. Observed ~12% CPU increase on a 10k req/day simulation when normalizing timezone on the fly. Considering pre-computing local_date in ETL for heavy tenants.
2026-03-11 Priya Raman: Decision - add optional precomputed local_date column upstream for tenants over 100k events/day. Default path will compute at export time for smaller tenants.

2026-03-12 Jordan Lee: PR opened - https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/2345. Includes watermark store schema migration, rollup generator, and S3 signed multipart helper. Needs review from infra and security for KMS usage with signed URLs.
2026-03-12 DevOps (Elaine Chu): Noted we need S3 lifecycle policy guidance for large per-tenant archives; raised as follow-up (ENG-81210).
2026-03-13 QA (Marco Alvarez): Added test plan for DST edge cases. Found an off-by-one bug in weekly rollups when tenant locale uses Monday vs Sunday week start; patch in PR.
notes: Implementation notes: Use IANA tz database via timezone library to compute local_date; avoid naive offset arithmetic. Store watermarks as UTC timestamp + local_period_end for auditability.
Performance: For tenants with heavy event throughput enable an upstream transform that writes local_date to the events topic to avoid repeated timezone conversions during export generation.
Delivery: For S3 use presigned multipart uploads; for webhook use signed delivery manifest with idempotency-key header. Include md5 checksum and line-count in manifest for recipient verification.
Observability: Emit metric exports.watermark_lag_seconds{tenant_id,period} and a histogram exports.payload_bytes to alert on growth. Add dashboard panel for 'delivery success rate' by tenant tier.
